Sertraline helps me out beyond words. The anxiety is near-enough completely dulled and the depressive dips are much less sharp and jarring. The other thing that helped me was going to the gym and eating better.

I had dealt with and knew that I probably did have depression, on the other hand, for a number of years. I shared this with no-one until I had medication in my pocket. It felt wrong to claim the pain until I was sure of what it was.

Panic attacks are the result of what is essentially a self-administered overdose of all of the shit that is meant to make you ‘fly’ in a fight or flight situation. Too many stress hormones all at once. Can be triggered by anything. IKEA fucks with me in particular. Weird.
